name: faq-block
title: FAQ block
description: The site's FAQ: the section head, a lead and a quiet button on the left, held under the header while the questions scroll by on the right; one answer open at a time, the rows sliding to make room and the plus turning to a minus. `layout="stack"` puts the head over a narrow list. The rows also stand alone as FaqAccordion.
use_for: The questions section of a home, pricing, product or contact page (place it in a section with the page's padding); FaqAccordion alone where the page sets its own head.
never: Answers the product does not state
More than one answer open at once
source: Site v3/V3Faq, ui/FaqAccordion and v2/V2Faq V2FaqList (V3Faq.module.css, V2Faq.module.css): 4fr and 7fr columns 64px apart from 1024, the head sticky at the header plus 32px, centered on phones; .t-lead 24px under the head, the quiet docs button 32px further; rows under --line hairlines, 20px (24 from 768) above and below a 20/28 --text-2 question, a 12px plus of 2px strokes; the answer 16/24 --text-2 at 640px, 24px (32 from 768) under; slots sized to the longest answer, rows sliding over --dur-move on --ease-out; the v2 list centered at 640 + 80px with its hairline at the foot

examples.name: Questions
examples.label: Questions about the plan
examples.content:
<!-- Questions answered only with what the plan and the assets say. -->
<spyglass-faq-block heading="Frequently asked questions" body="Everything Acme's team asked before starting." action='{"label":"Contact us","href":"#contact"}' items='[{"q":"What does the Creator plan cost?","a":"$10 for your first month, then $20/month."},{"q":"How many people can use it?","a":"Unlimited team seats come with the plan."},{"q":"Which networks are in the index?","a":"Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creatives in one index."},{"q":"How long does it take to add a brand?","a":"Add any brand or creator in under a minute."}]'></spyglass-faq-block>

examples.name: Stack
examples.label: Head over a narrow list
examples.content:
<!-- The earlier site's arrangement: the head centered over a narrow list. -->
<spyglass-faq-block head-id="faq-stack" layout="stack" heading="Questions, answered" items='[{"q":"What does the Creator plan cost?","a":"$10 for your first month, then $20/month."},{"q":"How many people can use it?","a":"Unlimited team seats come with the plan, so everyone who makes or reviews creative can search."},{"q":"Which networks are in the index?","a":"Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creatives in one index."},{"q":"How long does it take to add a brand?","a":"Add any brand or creator in under a minute."}]'></spyglass-faq-block>
